title: Customer appointment scheduling
summary: Online booking for a multi-location clinic

input.request: Our dental clinics take all appointments by phone. Receptionists spend most of the morning on calls, patients complain they can't get through, and missed appointments are a growing problem because reminders are only sent when staff have time to call. We would like patients to book, reschedule and cancel appointments online and receive automatic reminders.
input.stakeholders: Patients, receptionists, dentists and hygienists, practice managers
input.existing_systems: Practice management system used for patient records and the appointment diary
input.constraints: Patient information is confidential health data.
